notes: The supplied me of ye saved me not answers to no object morpheme and is correctly added under rule 44; the אַיִן keeps the negation and heads on not (rule 50) while its suffix takes the subject pronoun ye.

לָמָה is segmented as preposition plus interrogative and rendered by the single wherefore, so the pair fuses under rule 30, headed on מָה, which carries the wh-lexeme; the waw beside it takes the resumptive then written for it (rule 14).

Both cohortative he morphemes are unrepresented (rule 32), and in הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה the single written determiner this goes to the demonstrative pronoun, leaving both articles unrepresented (rules 41, 47).
The opening waw takes And when as one rendering (rule 55), headed on the coordinator; some corpus units head such a pair on when.
